abstract: Twelve cases of testicular cancer were treated at our Department of Urology between 1984 and 1985. The mean age of the patients was 35.2 years old. Eight of them were pure seminoma in histology, other cases were non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGT). Seven cases were of stage I testicular cancer, 3 cases were of stage IIA, and 2 cases were of stage IIB. Patients with stages I and IIA seminoma were given radiation to the ipsilateral iliac and bilateral paraaortic caval nodes to the crura of the diaphragma. Two patients with stage IIB seminoma were treated with PVB therapy and retroperitoneal lymph node resection. Chemotherapy containing CDDP was effective to reduce the tumor size. Two cases were of stage I NSGT, one case was treated with high orchiectomy only, and the other case was treated with chemotherapy after high orchiectomy. Chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node resection were given to two patients with stage IIA NSGT. Abnormally elevated values of lactate dehydrogenase were observed in cases with a primary tumors weight larger than about 100 g. Six of the 8 cases of pure seminoma had slightly elevated beta-human chorionic gonadotropin levels. Two cases with bilateral testicular cancer were found among the 12 cases so that necessity of meticulous palpation of remaining testis was felt. Recurrent change was not observed in any of the 12 cases so that testicular cancer is considered to be an almost curable disease.
abstract_ja: 12例の精巣がんを1984年から1985年にかけて当泌尿器科で治療した。患者の平均年齢は35.2歳であった。組織学的にはピュアセミノーマが8例、その他は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGT)であった。7例が病期I、3例が病期IIA、2例が病期IIBであった。病期IおよびIIAのセミノーマ患者には、同側の腸骨リンパ節と、横隔膜脚に至る両側の大動脈傍・大静脈傍リンパ節に放射線照射を行った。病期IIBのセミノーマ2例はPVB療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清で治療した。CDDPを含む化学療法は腫瘍縮小に有効であった。NSGTの病期I 2例のうち、1例は高位精巣摘除術のみ、もう1例は高位精巣摘除術後に化学療法を行った。病期IIA NSGTの2例には化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った。乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)の異常高値は、原発腫瘍重量が約100gを超える症例で認められた。ピュアセミノーマ8例中6例で血清β-hCGがわずかに上昇していた。12例中2例は両側精巣がんであり、残存精巣の入念な触診の必要性が認められた。再発は12例のいずれにもみられず、精巣がんはほぼ治癒可能な疾患と考えられる。
